title: From Conflict to Consensus: Boosting Medical Reasoning via Multi-Round Agentic RAG
authors: Wenhao Wu; Zhentao Tang; Yafu Li; Shixiong Kai; Mingxuan Yuan; Chunlin Chen; Zhi Wang
why_relevant: Proposes adaptive multi-round RAG that uses semantic conflict among candidate answers as a signal to trigger retrieval, addressing noisy token-level uncertainty and long-context degradation. Relevant to adaptive retrieval control and conflict-based refinement.
why_not_or_caveat: Domain-specific (medical QA); robustness framing is secondary to test-time scaling for reasoning.
suggested_section: Calibration and control: when to retrieve
